name: Farm Pond (Khet Talai) Nirman Karyakram
benefit:
- Subsidy breakdown:

   1. Raw farm pond: 50% of the construction cost (capped at ₹52,500)
   1. Plastic lined farm pond: 50% of the construction cost with lining (capped at ₹75,000)

- Additional subsidy:

   1. Raw farm pond: Up to 60% of the total cost (capped at ₹63,000)
   1. Plastic lined farm pond: Up to 60% of the total cost (capped at ₹90,000)
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. All categories of farmers are eligible.
1. The applicant farmer should have a minimum cultivable land of 0.5 hectares at one place on his name.
